mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM message WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, title, content, type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND type != 'SYSTEM' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, content, type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND type = 'SYSTEM' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND type != 'SYSTEM'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (user_id, title, content, type, is_read) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{isRead})
INSERT INTO message (user_id, title, content, type, is_read) VALUES (#{uid}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id AS user_id, u.phone AS phone, m.title, m.content, m.type, m.is_read, m.create_time FROM message m JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%') ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
